==Biography==
===Before Becoming a Pro===
Tian was clearly a genius in League of Legends; at age of 13, he had already achieved Diamond 1 in Chinese super server. After witnessing [[Clearlove]], his idol winning [[2015 Mid-Season Invitational]], he decided to become a pro. Noticed by [[PDD]], the boss of [[Young Miracles]], Tian received his first offer of joining [[Young Miracles]] as a young prospect. 

===2017 Season===
in 2017, Tian joined [[Young Miracles]], known as the "West Point" of LPL, as the substitute of [[Ning]]. After Ning left the team for [[Invictus Gaming]], Tian eventually got his chance to play in the [[LDL]] games. That year, [[Young Miracles]] did not get promoted to [[LPL]].

===2018 Season===
With the help of his boss, [[PDD]], Tian and his teammate, [[Knight (Zhuo Ding)]] were both introduced to [[Suning]]. Nonetheless, while Knight soon won himself a place in the team, Tian struggled to compete with the other jungler in [[Suning]], [[H4cker]]. In the end of the season, Tian left the team for [[FunPlus Phoenix]].

===2019 Season===
Tian joined [[FunPlus Phoenix]] in 2019, a year that Tian finally grew and shined. Influenced and tutored by FPX's mid laner, [[Doinb]], Tian soon formed great chemistry with the team and won [[LPL 2019 Summer Playoffs]]. Then, [[FunPlus Phoenix]] participated in [[2019 World Championship]] as the first seed of [[LPL]]. Though struggled in group stage, Tian and his team dominated in the knockout stage, where they successfully defeated [[Fnatic]] and [[Invictus Gaming]]. In the final against [[G2 Esports]], [[FunPlus Phoenix]] crashed their component with 3:0, with Tian's stellar performance in jungling. Tian was later chosen as the MVP of the final.

== Trivia ==
* Known for his {{ci|Qiyana}} and {{ci|Lee Sin}}.
* His ID '''Tian''' is based on his given name (Tian-Liang).
* Was the MVP of the [[2019 Season World Championship|Worlds 2019]] Finals.
* Is a huge anime fan.
* Featured in "Take Over" - Worlds 2020 promotional music video as a side character.
* In early 2021, he had to take a break from the competitive scene due to overwhelming stress.
* Is nicknamed tortoise with garlic (蒜头王八), which is also a nickname for the pokemon Bulbasaur.
